purpose: Independent held-out basket-depth validation for the v87 Broadcast pinhole camera. No rim pixel in this file is used to fit the v87 camera.
annotation_policy: Native 960x540 immutable Frame C only. Samples trace the source-visible upper/inside orange rim contour from left to right. The orange ball at smaller x and the rim support/bracket at larger x are excluded. Placement is from direct source-pixel inspection only; no v87 projection, solver residual, cross-camera transfer, generated pixels, player geometry or ball geometry is used.

metric_model.coordinate_system: backboard face x=0; +x into court; y=0 basket centre; floor z=0
metric_model.note: The regulation 18-inch inside-edge circle at the 10-foot upper-edge plane is used as the independent metric reference. The image contour is intentionally not used as a fitted residual; v88 measures nearest image distance only. At this source resolution the metal-tube contour is not claimed to support sub-pixel tube-thickness modelling.

guardrail: A good rim projection validates the event camera's image-space basket geometry but does not, by itself, prove that focal length, principal point and physical camera centre are uniquely identifiable. Physical-centre permission remains false unless the inherited 75 cm perturbation-stability gate is independently satisfied.
